title: Paloma and the Orchard
author: R. M. Marchetti
blurb: Ulyana Vane, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
